image_description: A vintage black typewriter viewed from a high angle. The image features a complex mechanical assembly with round, gold-rimmed keys, a curved type-bar basket, and a carriage return lever. The focus is on the keyboard area, specifically the bottom row where the space bar is located.

The guide stems for the round keys are inconsistent; some appear to float or merge into the keyboard deck without clear mechanical attachment points, suggesting a lack of physical grounding.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight warping of the straight edges of the typewriter body on the right side, where the line curves unnaturally.
